purpose.domain_detail: Italian insurance system (NEWLIFE project) - DB2 database access module for movement/transaction records (MOVI table) with filtering by object type, movement type, and effective date range
purpose.summary: This is a DB2 database access subprogram for the NEWLIFE insurance project. It provides SELECT, OPEN/CLOSE CURSOR, and FETCH operations on a MOVI (movements/transactions) table, supporting three treatment modes: by effect date (WC-EFF), by competence date (WC-CPZ), and without historicization (WC-NST). The program acts as a data access layer called via a service interface (IDSV0003).

notable_features: EXEC SQL embedded DB2 (DECLARE CURSOR, OPEN, CLOSE, FETCH, SELECT INTO)
EXEC SQL INCLUDE for multiple copybooks (SQLCA, IDSV0003, IDBDMOV0, IDBVMOV1-3, LDBV2651)
Structured service interface pattern with return codes and operation type flags
verdict.notes: Source truncated at 16000 chars (602 total lines, ~443 code lines). The program is part of a larger Italian insurance system framework. The '10819X' sequence numbers visible in SQL WHERE clauses appear to be sequence number artifacts in fixed-format source. The WC-EFF and WC-CPZ sections appear to be stubs (SET IDSV0003-INVALID-OPER TO TRUE) while WC-NST is fully implemented.
